statement: Each entry of a calculated dict is drawn by the template of its own class: an entry the library leaves empty reads "no value", keeps its formula, offers no chart.
reason: Today the dict template sends every entry that is not a quantity to the hourly chart, the empty ones included. The top-level section already includes by class. reason: A raw 500 is swapped nowhere: a stale pane and no error (constitution §1.4). A view's own not-found is as silent, on a stale Sources row: it shows the modal and keeps its 404, a missing thing being no server error. A full page, a download, a fetched endpoint stays as it is. The chart preparers gain no empty-value branch.

units.name: Bug: The chart button of an empty dict entry fails with nothing shown

text: In an edge computer's panel, three entries of the edge storage offer a chart: the library leaves them empty on purpose. The button answers a raw 500, which the page swaps nowhere: an empty chart pane, and no error. Any fragment that fails is as silent. Task 9, diagnosed in [hourly-chart-empty-timeseries-500.md](diagnostics/hourly-chart-empty-timeseries-500.md).

units.name: Bug: A formula button opens another object's explanation

text: In a panel that shows several objects, an edge computer with its CPU, RAM and storage, the RAM's formula button puts its explanation in the CPU's row and opens all three rows. One more click, and the RAM's explanation cannot be reached until the panel is reopened. Task 10, diagnosed in [calculated-attribute-collapse-id-collision.md](diagnostics/calculated-attribute-collapse-id-collision.md).

lots: calculated-attribute-panel (easy) #dict-entry-own-template #fragment-views-show-modal #explanation-ids-per-item — Both bugs are of the calculated-attribute panel and share its templates and one test file. The ids come last: the dict piece sends the empty entries through the templates whose ids they fix.
